multiplicity.note: Cells overlap (a row sits in one core cell per surface and one cell per slice), so these counts are not independent; read them as a scale, not a test.

note: Every outcome (home, draw, away) of every match with Pinnacle's full early and close 1X2 and a walk-forward model chance. x = the market's Shin-fair chance, y = the model's chance minus the market's, z = won minus the market's chance, averaged per cell; z > 0 where the model liked an outcome (y > 0) means the model was right there. Ranges resample matches within each cell (2,000 draws, seed 0). Cells under 200 rows are marked thin. Seasons 2019/20-2023/24; 2024/25 on is locked as the test season for anything the map suggests. Two scope limits: 'after a European match' counts UEFA matches only (domestic cups are not counted), and rest days count league matches only. A slice level that holds every outcome of its matches (league, month) has a total z of 0 by construction (each match's outcomes sum to one win and to a chance of 1); read its bands, not its total.
warning: Exploratory. With this many cells some will look striking by chance: with no real pattern about 5% of cells would have a z range that excludes 0 (see `multiplicity`). The strategy search found 2% of its large rules beating the close under no skill, and its best rule was luck (p = 0.94). A cell that stands out is a lead to pre-register and test on data this map never read (2024/25 is kept locked for that), not a finding.
